meta.purpose: Prove the register's six counts are distinct quantities and reconcile.

column_semantics.major_environments: One per chapter (the ENV entry). Counted as a location entry.
column_semantics.other_locations_not_interiors: SUB + SET + LMK + TRV + EXP + BOS. Excludes interiors by definition.
column_semantics.interiors_location_entries: INT entries. 'Interiors that appear only as scenes are counted as scenes, not as locations.'
column_semantics.scenes_and_microlocations: SCN entries. A scene is not a location.
column_semantics.not_main_or_secondary_story: Subset of the scenes column: scenes whose category is neither MAIN STORY nor SECONDARY STORY.

MAJOR_ENVIRONMENT.description: One per chapter. The chapter's exterior world.
MAJOR_ENVIRONMENT.contains: every other location in the chapter

LOCATION.description: A named place the player can be at: sub-location, settlement, landmark, traversal area, exploration area, boss arena.
LOCATION.double_count_risk: An interior listed as a location AND described by a scene with the same name is one place. The register counts the scene, not the location, when the interior exists only as a scene.

INTERIOR.description: An interior that has its own location entry.
INTERIOR.double_count_risk: HIGHEST. The register states that interiors appearing only as scenes are counted as scenes. Never add INT count to SCN count and call the result 'places'.

SCENE.description: A staged moment or micro-location with its own board, category, access level and NPC content. Includes EXTERIOR MICRO-LOCATION scenes.
SCENE.contains: nothing; belongs to exactly one parent location
SCENE.double_count_risk: Micro-locations are scenes. Do not add them again.

ENVIRONMENT_STATE.description: A time, weather or supernatural variant of one location (night, rain, market day, supernatural). Belongs to a location.
ENVIRONMENT_STATE.double_count_risk: A state is a multiplier on one place, not a place. 40 state refs do not mean 40 more locations.

containment_rules: A scene has exactly one parent location.
A location has zero or more scenes.
An environment state has exactly one parent location and is not a location.
Environment state ids never collide with location ids.
A location entry's chapter prefix matches its major environment's chapter.
Location entries = major_environments + other_locations + interiors. Scenes and states are excluded from that sum by definition.
meta.ingestion_status: Chapter 1 parsed for locations (partial) and scenes (complete). Chapters 2-8 arithmetic-checked on published numbers only.

location_entries.note: Corrects the earlier figure of 191 in canon_index.json v2.0.0, which was arithmetically wrong. 8+142+46 = 196.

main_or_secondary_story_scenes.note: Independently corroborated by the scene register v1.9 category counts: MAIN STORY 4 + SECONDARY STORY 9 = 13.

scenes_with_missing_parent.note: Expected non-zero while the location fixture is a partial capture. Classified as INGESTION GAP, not a register defect.
